_comment: Developer hand-off to the approver (DESIGN §1.23.7). Posted mechanically when the dev replies `done` — the first and only time the approver is @-mentioned in the topic under the self-service loop. ISSUE_STATUS_PARAGRAPHS is the fix ledger (built defensively by mechanical_reply_handler._handoff_status_paragraphs, not from a VERIFIED_ISSUES structured var); REJECTED_SECTION_PARAGRAPHS carries the dev's disputed issues plus their stated reasons and vanishes when nothing was rejected; ESCALATE_INSTRUCTION_PARAGRAPHS is passed only when review.triage == "simple".
